# Devliora

> Devliora designs and builds production-grade software systems for
> enterprise teams: APIs, platforms, and the infrastructure that holds
> them together.

Devliora is built and led by Niloy Kumar Barman. The site's own framing:
every claim it makes is backed by a running system rather than a sales
deck — JWT rotation with revocation, per-IP rate limiting, Redis
cache-aside across domain entities, and a public, linear commit history.
The stated goal is to build software the way a large agency should,
without the overhead of one.
